title: Audit twelve modules and report what is actually broken

manual_checks.instruction: Read the submitted findings for wording quality: does each claimed/expected pair describe the defect a reader could act on, independent of the executed reproduction?
Check whether the submission distinguished the spec-conformant oddities from defects in its own prose, rather than reporting everything it noticed.

notes: Twelve independent Fieldnotes modules, six seeded behavioral defects and five spec-conformant oddities. Findings are validated by executing the submitted reproduction against the frozen modules shipped with this pack and comparing with the oracle for the same (module, export); wording is never matched. Verdicts are joined to findings by stable finding ID plus source revision (private/aggregate.mjs), never by list index. The grader validates reproduction.module against the exact allow-list of frozen module basenames and verifies containment before anything is imported, and executes reproductions in a forked worker that never learns the report path; the supervisor rebuilds the report from its own check list and records anything unexpected in details.tamperSignals. This defends the grade against forgery, not the machine: it is not a sandbox.
